subject: Partner-led discovery: Redwood <> CloudBridge — next steps / demo scheduling

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partner-led discovery: Redwood <> CloudBridge — next steps / demo scheduling

Hi Oliver / CloudBridge team,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking through your marketplace integration goals. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we can align calendars: 

Key takeaways:
- CloudBridge is aiming to offer Redwood-hosted inference as a marketplace offering for enterprise customers (SSO, private deployments, and usage metering are top asks).
- Primary buyer: platform/ops teams (security + cost controls).
- Success criteria: predictable latency under load, integration with marketplace billing, and SSO + audit logs.

Proposed next step:
- Tech deep-dive / demo with our SE (Mateo) to cover integration patterns (marketplace flow, SSO, and private deployment options).
- Suggested windows (PT):
  * Tue Mar 3, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
  * Wed Mar 4, 9:00–10:00 AM PT

Please let me know which window works best and who from your side should join (technical lead + product/partner ops). I’ve attached a short partner one-pager that summarizes our marketplace capabilities.

Agenda (proposed):
1) 15 min: short demo of Redwood marketplace flow + hosted API overview
2) 30 min: Mateo runs integration patterns and SSO/keys discussion
3) 15 min: open Q&A and next steps / mutual action plan

If those times don’t fit, drop a Calendly link and we’ll pick a time.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partner Success | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
